title: Socratic checklist — screening & eligibility (纳排)
rationale: Before screening starts, the agent asks and answers each question; answers are recorded and the gate checks completeness. Sources are chapter/item-level references, not page numbers.

items.question: Do the exclusion criteria (language, year, report type, publication status) risk creating a selective gap in the evidence map?
items.rationale: Language and publication bias are well-documented threats; time bounds must match the certificate's time window.
items.source: Cochrane Handbook v6 Ch.4 (searching for and selecting studies); PRISMA 2020 item 7
items.answer_format: yes/no + which criteria could create a gap + mitigation

items.question: Are the eligibility criteria exactly consistent with the certificate's PICOT primitives?
items.rationale: Any drift between the certificate and the protocol criteria invalidates the derivation.
items.source: PRISMA 2020 item 5; Cochrane Handbook v6 Ch.3
items.answer_format: field-by-field mapping certificate -> criteria, or explicit deviation with justification

items.question: Are subgroup eligibility choices consistent with the certificate's hypothesized effect-modification pattern?
items.rationale: Screening decisions that preselect a subgroup define the estimand and must match the hypothesis.
items.source: Cochrane Handbook v6 Ch.3 (defining the review question)
items.answer_format: list subgroup filters and state which hypothesis node they serve

items.question: Is any record excluded on abstract-only grounds where the full report could change the decision?
items.rationale: Abstract-only judgments are a known source of false exclusions.
items.answer_format: count of abstract-only exclusions + rule for escalation

items.question: Are title/abstract and full-text decisions made by at least two independent actors with recorded conflict arbitration?
items.rationale: Dual independent screening is the high-assurance default.
items.source: Cochrane Handbook v6 Ch.4; MECIR C39-42
items.answer_format: actor identities, independence, disagreement count, arbitration method

items.question: Is every exclusion reason recorded per record so PRISMA flow counts are reproducible?
items.rationale: Flow-diagram counts must trace to per-record decisions.
items.answer_format: exclusion-reason vocabulary + coverage check (excluded = all counted)

items.question: Are companion/duplicate reports merged onto their study per the lineage rules before eligibility counting?
items.rationale: Counting reports instead of studies inflates the flow diagram.
items.source: PRISMA 2020 item 3; Cochrane Handbook v6 Ch.4

items.question: Are trial registries and grey sources covered and their coverage recorded?
items.rationale: Unpublished and ongoing studies affect both completeness and publication-bias assessment.

items.question: Is the time boundary consistent with the certificate's novelty gate and living-update window?
items.rationale: The search window must reflect the gap the certificate claims.

items.question: Which borderline excluded studies would most change the review if included?
items.rationale: A sensitivity list of near-miss exclusions makes the screening boundary auditable.
items.source: Cochrane Handbook v6 Ch.4; PRISMA 2020 item 16b
